submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gave the highest signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocation at 35 GeV: 91.0%, against 85.0% for L1 and 73.3% for L3. This matches the 2025 summary. I found no latency figures for any candidate in the project documents, and the simulation tool doesn't report latency. The 4.0 us hard limit is therefore unverified. Iterative topological clustering may be the slowest of the three, so L2 is a conditional recommendation. Someone must confirm its FPGA latency is 4.0 us or less before firmware freeze. If it exceeds the limit, fall back to L1, then L3. I only simulated 35 GeV and did not scan other thresholds.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: At 35 GeV the simulation gives L2 91.0%, L1 85.0%, L3 73.3%. Other thresholds were not scanned, so the threshold is not shown to be optimal.
No latency data in candidate_specs, links, schedule, notes or the simulation output. The specs only say the resource budget (LUTs, DSPs) is fine.
